en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European spa town in a narrow valley with tree‑covered hills in the background. Multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades line a riverside promenade; signs on the houses advertise banks, hotels, and restaurants. People walk along the street and by the river. The architecture is Central European with mansard roofs and decorative gables.
